fields.reasoning: The leaf's 'no journal entry for 20 minutes' rule contradicts the code: session.Stalled (internal/session/status.go, StallAfter 20m on the session report), runStalledAll and RunStalled (internal/api/run.go) and the watchdog's progress check all judge a stall by session reports, and the inbox already lists these as InboxStalled (internal/api/inbox.go:406). Builders report progress without writing journal entries, so the journal rule would show working builders as stuck on Home while rhiza inbox shows nothing, and a really stalled run would get two cards. The change set's intent is that Home answers 'does anything need me?' from the same truth as the inbox; reusing the existing stalled item keeps one definition, matches the watchdog, and needs no new rule.
fields.statement: Home's stuck run is the inbox's stalled item, not a rule of its own: a live run is stuck exactly when rhiza inbox lists it as stalled (RunStalled / InboxStalled: a session of its current step silent for more than 20 minutes, working or idle in an autonomous run, not waiting on an answer or paused at a usage limit). Home shows one stuck card per such inbox item and never a second card for the same run, and web-home-needs-you's statement and acceptance say so: its stuck-run fixture is a run whose session last reported over 20 minutes ago, and a run whose session reported 5 minutes ago (even with no journal entry for 20 minutes) is not stuck.
